reason: The current gated-attention GRU improves macro validation HR@10 from 0.5050 to 0.5188 but loses accuracy on Movies_and_TV and Electronics, motivating a controlled test of learned retrieval projections without establishing attention as the cause. Historical recurrent and sampled-softmax experiments support preserving the backbone and objective; unsuccessful contextualization and endpoint-only experiments do not justify broader changes. Modify model_design for projected causal attention and training_evaluation solely to ensure faithful checkpoint reconstruction and prediction.

plan.model_design: Inside GRURec, replace parameter-free attention with separate jointly trained query, key, value, and context-output nn.Linear(dim, dim, bias=False) projections, preserving the constructor signature, existing variable names, forward(self, seq), score_features(self, features, candidates), and predict(self, seq, candidates). Compute projected queries, keys, and values from features immediately after the GRU, form scores = (queries @ keys.transpose(1, 2)) * (features.shape[-1] ** -0.5), and apply the existing causal and nonpadding allowed mask. Preserve the safe handling of fully masked padding queries, compute context from weights @ values, project context back to dim, and explicitly zero padded contexts before the unchanged features + gate * context residual with gate bias initialized to -2. This isolates whether independently learned matching and transmitted features improve retrieval while retaining the historically supported recurrent representation; preserve the two 128-dimensional GRU layers, embeddings, jointly trained item bias, normalization, dropout, and output projection. Keep ranking_loss(model, seq, target) unchanged, including sampled cross-entropy at temperature one, the current code's NEGATIVES=1024 rather than the historical 256, MAX_POSITIONS=2048, training-window negative masking, and differentiable zero-loss fallback.
plan.training_evaluation: Preserve write_predict_script() and ensure its inspect.getsource(GRURec) embedding includes all four new projection layers and the complete modified forward implementation, so working/predict.py reconstructs GRURec from the saved config and strictly loads every parameter. Preserve predict(user_id, history, candidates, *, dataset_name=None), all four category routes, existing checkpoint filenames, and identical history truncation, right padding, and scoring between validation and prediction. Keep unchanged preprocessing seed 0 through the supplied splits, training seed 42, evaluation seed 42, HistoryDataset prefix sampling, MAXLEN, batch size, AdamW settings, scheduler, clipping, STEPS, SASREC_EPOCHS default 200, validation cadence, 35-epoch early stopping, time allowances, and HR@10 checkpoint selection with NDCG@10 tie-breaking. Train exactly one fresh network per category on a single GPU, load exactly one selected checkpoint per category, retain DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'] and trial-local WORKING artifacts, and prohibit ensembles, checkpoint averaging, independent auxiliary scorers, other-trial checkpoint reuse, external data, and hidden-test access. Assess the projected-attention hypothesis through the unchanged pinned host macro validation HR@10 on 200 users per category with 99 unique negatives; treat the proposed 0.005–0.015 absolute gain over 0.5188 as an unmeasured expectation and leave final held-out evaluation to the host.
